desc: Define the four diagonal direction vectors and a clockwise-turn mapping; verify with the examples that "clockwise" depends on current direction (e.g., down-right → down-left).
Derive an iterative DP: compute run-length tables per direction by iterating cells in reverse order along each diagonal, storing both parities or inferring parity from position.
Design the main search: turn candidates via leg-table sweeps + f_{cw(d)} continuation; no-turn candidates from 1-cells; total = 1 + leg + cont.
Implement `lenOfVDiagonal` with f_d run-length tables for 4 directions, leg sweeps with turn candidates, and no-turn candidates from 1-cells.

Test the implementation against the 4 provided examples plus edge cases: [[1]], all-zeros grid, 1 with no valid continuation, turn at last cell (cont=0), and a case where best path turns immediately after one step; verify O(n·m) performance on a 500×500 random grid.
